original_test_intent: Read the VLAN collection associated with one selected Manager EthernetInterface and inventory segmentation resources without altering interface or VLAN configuration.
original_method: Resolve the selected EthernetInterface and its canonical VLANs link, issue one trusted GET, validate collection/member identity and interface relationship, redact segmentation data and confirm no configuration change.
manual_activity: Provide read-only access, firmware schema and the approved segmentation-evidence policy; select the parent interface through collection membership and its advertised VLANs link.
safety_requirements: Resolve VLANs from the exact parent interface
Do not repair malformed spacing by blind string assumption
Never PATCH, POST or follow network actions
Redact VLAN IDs and related topology according to policy
agent_execution_scope: Bind BMC, Manager, parent interface and firmware identity
Capture HTTP metadata and restricted raw hash
Validate collection type, count and members
Validate each member belongs to the selected interface and has unique canonical identity
Validate safe enabled/status fields when supported
Export report and confirm no network/log mutation
engineer_actions: Provide optional expected VLAN set and redaction policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The normalized GET targets the intended collection only if the parent advertises that URI; it does not justify silently correcting the malformed source path, and insecure/raw evidence handling remains unacceptable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Traverse from the validated interface to its canonical VLANs link, perform one trusted GET, validate parent/member consistency and redact segmentation data without writes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manager/interface VLANs GET and 15/10 timing remain; no interface ID, VLAN ID, member count or desired configuration is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use link-driven collection discovery and validate VLAN membership as a child graph of the selected interface.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces malformed/manual path construction with canonical linkage, internal consistency, trusted access and segmentation privacy.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers reported VLAN resources only; it does not test tagged traffic, switch configuration, routing, isolation or VLAN writes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metadata may not reflect upstream switch membership or live reachability, and redacted evidence cannot be used to reconstruct a desired configuration without the protected source.

project_override_considerations: If the firmware represents VLAN state inline rather than as a collection, use the authoritative schema and record the model difference; do not probe guessed child URIs. Expected VLANs require project-supplied data.
expected_evidence: Parent membership and canonical VLANs URI
HTTP status/content type/timing and restricted raw hash
Collection identity/count and unique child members
Proof no VLAN/interface write, action or log clear occurred

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and command consistently identify the interface VLAN collection. The stray path space is a malformed representation resolved through canonical discovery, not a competing test target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Parent identity, link, access, schema and redaction policy are identifiable normal inputs for deterministic read-only automation.

review_improvement: Replaces a malformed-path raw dump with a parent-bound, internally consistent and privacy-controlled VLAN inventory.
independent_technical_reasoning: VLAN membership is scoped to a particular EthernetInterface, so the collection must be reached from and validated against that exact parent. Normalizing a visible spacing error is insufficient evidence of the correct URI; the live advertised link or firmware schema is authoritative. Collection count, unique child identities and parent containment are machine-checkable. VLAN identifiers expose segmentation design, so exported evidence needs policy-driven redaction while a restricted hash preserves audit integrity. No configuration or traffic claims follow from this GET.
